records.name: AI agents query the warehouse directly

cells.name: AI agents query the warehouse directly
cells.description:
Analytics and AI agents now read warehouse tables without a human in the loop, so a broken column reaches an automated decision before anyone sees a dashboard.
- Snowflake and Databricks both shipped agent query features this quarter (vendor announcements, Sep 2026).
Data teams will be asked to prove the data an agent read was fresh and correct.

records.name: EU AI Act data governance duties

cells.name: EU AI Act data governance duties
cells.description: High-risk AI systems must document the quality and lineage of their training and input data, which pulls data observability into compliance reviews for EU companies.
